leagues.name: Wood
leagues.blurb: The opponent walks at random. Go and get the seeds.
leagues.ref:
def play(state):
    x, y = state["me"]
    if not state["seeds"]:
        return "STAY"
    sx, sy = min(state["seeds"], key=lambda s: abs(s[0]-x) + abs(s[1]-y))
    if sx > x: return "E"
    if sx < x: return "W"
    if sy > y: return "S"
    if sy < y: return "N"
    return "STAY"

leagues.name: Gold
leagues.blurb: The opponent finds real paths around walls. Win the races it cannot win.

leagues.name: Legend
leagues.blurb: The opponent weighs distance and denial. Out-think it. Three wins of five is enough.

rules: Board is 11x11. You start top-left, the opponent bottom-right; the walls are mirrored and you swap sides in alternate matches, so it is fair.
Each turn both bots move one step at the same time: N, E, S, W or STAY.
Stepping onto a seed collects it (+1). If both want the same cell, both bounce back. Seeds are shared: every seed is a race.
A new seed appears at a random cell every 2 turns. The match lasts 40 turns.
Win a league by taking enough of 5 fixed matches (see each league). Replay any match by its seed.
